title: morisonia polyantha
intro: Morisonia polyantha, commonly known as the "Bitter Apple" or "Bitter Calabar berry", is a plant species native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Morisonia polyantha include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant's bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects.
